description: This file implements link understanding logic, including scope resolution, command execution, and link extraction, for a media understanding system in a TypeScript project.

methods.name: resolveScopeDecision
methods.description: Determines whether link understanding is allowed or denied based on scope configuration.

methods.name: resolveTimeoutMsFromConfig
methods.description: Calculates timeout in milliseconds from configuration and default.

methods.name: runCliEntry
methods.description: Executes a CLI command to process a link, returning the output.

methods.name: runLinkEntries
methods.description: Attempts to process a link using multiple configured entries, returning the first successful output.

methods.name: runLinkUnderstanding
methods.description: Main function to analyze a message, extract links, and process them according to configuration.
